newsitem.title: USA: Pamela Lee reunites with alcoholic rocker husband.
newsitem.headline: Pamela Lee reunites with alcoholic rocker husband.

text.p: Two weeks after filing for divorce, actress Pamela Anderson Lee and her rock drummer husband Tommy Lee are reuniting to support his battle against alcoholism.

"All the ridiculous speculations on our marriage are false. I'm in recovery for alcohol abuse and my wife is supporting me through a very tough time," Tommy Lee said in a statement, released by a spokeswoman for the couple.
The statement did not say whether Pamela Lee's Nov. 19 divorce petition had been withdrawn and the spokeswoman declined to expand on the statement or discuss the status of the legal suit.
Pamela Lee, who separated from the Motley Crue drummer last month after 21 months, citing "irreconcilable differences," was unavailable for comment.
But the spokeswoman said the of the star of the "Baywatch" TV show had returned to the family home with their baby son Brandon Thomas, after living at a friend's ranch for the past two weeks.
The Canadian-born actress and the drummer, who was previously married to "Melrose Place" star Heather Locklear, were married on a beach in Mexico on Feb. 19, 1995, after only four days of courtship.
In October, a freelance photographer sued Tommy Lee for assault after a pushing incident outside the trendy Hollywood nightclub, "The Viper Room".
